propositions: HTTPS requests to /review/, /opcert/, and Gerrit location / can receive Location response headers with http:// scheme downgrades, while /mcp/ has the guarantee enforced via proxy_redirect rules

Both review-bot and opcert services run in containers with FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS unset, causing uvicorn to default to 127.0.0.1 trust list and drop X-Forwarded-Proto headers from untrusted docker-bridge connections, leading apps to build http:// absolute URLs

The fix adds per-location proxy_redirect rules to upgrade http:// to https:// for /review/, /opcert/, and Gerrit, each restating proxy_redirect default first to preserve existing prefix-stripping rewrites

Setting FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS="*" on review-bot and opcert services allows them to trust nginx's forwarded proto and build https:// URLs at source, bounded by host-loopback publication and nginx literal X-Forwarded-Proto setting

Code fix (commit 25fd2cf6dd75) was merged to main but has not been deployed; live unauthenticated probes of the edge still reproduce http:// downgrade on /review/ paths (307 to http://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/health)
Deployment is deferred by autodeploy's in_flight review gauge holding >= 1, preventing any container restart or nginx reload needed to apply the merged configuration changes
